clips.title: The story
paras: Renferrel sends his research south to Tarren Mill, where the Forsaken press on with their plague studies. You carry his notes from Silverpine Forest to Apothecary Lydon in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Since escaping the Lich King's control, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has pursued a New Plague that could destroy both the living and the Scourge. The Royal Apothecary Society works under the Banshee Queen's relentless pressure to create it. Its researchers are scattered across Lordaeron, so they share chemical data and test findings to hasten their work.

Apothecary Renferrel works from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and sends you south with his recent findings for Apothecary Lydon. Your road leaves the pine woods and crosses the open pastures of Hillsbrad Foothills. Tarren Mill lies beneath the Alterac Mountains, serving the Forsaken as an outpost and a place to stage their research.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Royal Apothecary Society is under extreme pressure from the Dark Lady to develop a New Plague. We are working diligently and have made much progress. It is our belief that the success will be achieved much faster if we share information amongst the Society.
For that reason I want you to deliver my latest findings to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, a small town nestled in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The journey will be a long one.
Head south and stick to the roads. Follow the signs closely!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, most excellent. Apothecary Renferrel has my utmost respect. I am anxious to study his work.
